title: Encryption Governance & Observability Orchestrator (EEO)
creator: Amina Patel
description: Build an Encryption Evidence Orchestrator (EEO) that centralizes KMS/HSM event ingestion, correlates key lifecycle events with data residency and retention policies, and emits signed, tamper-evident evidence bundles for audits. The orchestrator should: 1) subscribe to cloud KMS/HSM event streams and customer-managed KMS connectors; 2) reconcile rotation and usage events with tenant residency metadata; 3) produce per-tenant compressed evidence artifacts (cryptographically signed) and upload them to the compliance bucket and SIEM; 4) surface a developer-friendly API and console integration for on-demand evidence pulls and proof-of-delivery receipts. This task implements the core service, schema for evidence bundles, and the pipeline to automate reporting to the Compliance Dashboard and external auditors.
acceptance_criteria: EEO service can ingest key creation, rotate, destroy, and access events from GCP KMS, AWS KMS, and on-prem HSM connectors within 60s of event emission
Evidence bundle schema v1 defined and reviewed (includes event stream slice, residency mapping, retention policy at time-of-event, signing metadata)
Bundles are signed with a service key and verifiable via published JWKS endpoint
Automated daily export job produces per-tenant artifacts and uploads to compliance S3/GCS path with lifecycle tags
API endpoint /evidence/{tenant}/{window} returns manifest and presigned download link; access requires RBAC and audit logging
End-to-end test where simulated rotation + access events produce a bundle that passes offline verifier (unit + integration)
tasks: Define evidence bundle JSON schema and canonical serialization format (contrib: security and legal)
Implement KMS/HSM adapter interface and connectors for AWS/GCP/on-prem agent
Build reconciliation worker to join events with tenant residency/retention metadata from Catalog Service
Implement signer service using internal signing key (rotateable) and expose verification JWKS
Create daily export pipeline, compression, and storage lifecycle tagging
Add Console integration: evidence list view, request evidence action, and progress indicator
Design RBAC checks and require SSO-linked auditing for evidence downloads
Write e2e tests and fuzz inputs for malformed event handling
Document runbook for compromise/rotated signing keys and emergency evidence re-signing
